finding: Before the fix, an outer group adding a layer and an inner group adding a block applied both before a deepest stacked locked edit was refused; parent refusal flags remained false and redo was lost. The red control failed six assertions.
change: Recursively preflight nested Builder groups against the initial document lock state, propagate locked refusal to each parent and leave all pending work available for explicit retry.
Reject null operations and cyclic group graphs on append; reject a null document when constructing a document operation.
Retain committed journals for undo/redo and expose nested refusal and cycle errors through existing Lua and Python bindings.
validation: A red-before three-level group control now preserves both parent changes and redo, then succeeds on the same group with explicit override and passes undo/redo. A reused outer group retains its prior undo journal after a later nested refusal.
C++, Lua and Python controls exercise nested refusal, direct/indirect cycles, null operations and null documents.

A macOS ARM64 fast compatibility run passed 184 kernel, builder, layer, selection, canvas, DXF/DWG and Lua/Python tests. Full binding-plan, actual PR-base and worktree checks plus 31 checker tests passed.
limits: Preflight uses lock state at the start of the group. Operations that change lock state before a later edit, or custom operations that fetch other entities, are not guaranteed atomic. Complex repeated successful stacks remain open.
Native GUI, other platforms and full format parity remain open. No support claim or generated fixture was added.
